Part I — Knowledge Base (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 31, English)
Kalyan Lok Explained, Chakra Intensity vs. Dimension, and Astral vs. Physical Chakra Activation

Sour ce: an Ashaeiynn Foundation session (~22 minutes) answering pr eviously-submitted member questions, with two live insession exchanges — one on video-r ecor ding logistics and one extended live Q&A on the mechanics of astral vs. physical chakra activation.
1. What Kalyan Lok Actually Is

1. Kalyan Lok is a lok (realm) that Bhaiya's own guru obtained specifically for the work of the practitioners' sukshma sharir (subtle body), granted with the permission of 1 1 devi-devatas . 2. Kalyan Lok itself contains 16 further distinct sub-lokas within it. 3. Kalyan Lok has no fixed scriptural description because dif ferent traditions and regions refer to this same realm by dif ferent names — Bhaiya uses "Kalyan Lok" specifically because that is the name given by guru-agya (his own guru's instruction), not because it is the realm's only or original name. 4. Kalyan Lok is described as a bridge — specifically , a bridge between Ashaeiynn and "Pr etaraj Sarkar" (the governing authority over spirits/pretas). All the negativity cleared from practitioners passes through this bridge: it is purified there, punished/disciplined there, and then cycled onward to Pretaraj Sarkar . 5. The 1 1 deities who pr eside over Kalyan Lok include Shiva-Shakti, Hanuman Ji Maharaj, Bhagwan Ram and Sita, and three distinct forms of Vishnu Bhagwan — plus three distinct forms of Bhaiya's own guru, visible there in a dif ferent aspect than how the guru appears in the physical world. 6. Among the forms of Hanuman Ji Maharaj present is a black-color ed (kala) Hanuman Ji Maharaj — this specific form exists particularly to burn away/destr oy tantric actions and curses (tantrik kriyas). 7. The shakti (power) used at Ashaeiynn to clear negativity operates through Kalyan Lok — the small "pass" (access) to this realm was granted to Bhaiya himself, along with the specific task of routing all negativity cleared here onward to Pretaraj Sarkar .
2. Why Negativity Is Sent to Kalyan Lok Rather Than Simply Removed

1. Bhaiya illustrates this with the household-trash analogy : a cleaning van picks up household waste each morning and dumps it far outside the city in a designated dump yard — it does not simply dump the trash just outside the house, because trash left nearby can simply blow back in. 2. Kalyan Lok functions as that distant dump yard for cleared negativity — the negativity is not just pushed away from the practitioner but relocated to a realm specifically designated to contain and process it, precisely so it cannot easily drift back. 3. At Kalyan Lok, cleared negativity under goes purification thr ough suffering/discipline — described using the analogy of beating a very soiled cloth to work the dirt out of it. Once suf ficiently purified and "fit" (worthy), the negativity is categorized and reassigned onward, specifically so it can never return to af flict the same person again.
3. Chakra "Activation" vs. Chakra Intensity

1. A common member question: if aura-checking shows a chakra is already "open" or "active," why does a hawan (fire ritual) still need to be performed for that same chakra? 2. Bhaiya's answer centers on a key distinction: a chakra being open is not the same as a chakra being at full intensity . He compares this to water pressure in a pipe — chakras are channels through which ener gy flows, and just because a channel is open does not mean it is flowing at the volume actually required. 3. Example given: a practitioner may need a chakra at 100% activation , but aura-checking may show it at only 30% active — during an aura-check, this would simply be reported as "this chakra is active," without conveying that it still needs to be raised the remaining 70%, because the ener gy required to activate drishti (spiritual sight) demands that fuller level of flow . 4. Over -charged chakras are also addressed: intensive, unsupervised meditation practice can cause one chakra (commonly the sahasrara/crown or a similar chakra) to become extremely overchar ged — for example reaching "200%" — while the remaining chakras stay severely underpowered (as low as 1-2% each). Hawan work in such cases reduces the over charged chakra's excess power and raises the underpower ed ones , bringing the whole system into alignment, since ener gy needs to be able to move freely from one chakra to another .
4. What a Hawan Actually Does: Dimension, Not One-Chakra-at-a-T ime Opening

1. Bhaiya's central clarification: hawans do not "open" chakras one at a time. In reality , a practitioner's chakras all break open together in the very first jolt (jhatka) of awakened kundalini shakti. 2. What subsequent hawans actually do is raise the practitioner's overall "dimension." Each hawan session lifts the kundalini shakti roughly 5 dimensions , and this rises and settles, rises and settles, in a repeating up-down-up pattern across each chakra stage. 3. By the time a practitioner has been through work associated with six to seven chakras , they have typically crossed appr oximately 45 to 50 dimensions in total. 4. Crossing r oughly 45-50% dimension is the thr eshold at which a practitioner's drishti can no longer be easily tamper ed with or interfered with by outside forces. 5. Bhaiya explains that "chakra" language is used deliberately as a simplified, layman's term for the sake of member understanding — most people do not intuitively grasp "we are raising your dimension," so the more familiar chakra-by-chakra framing is used instead, even though the underlying mechanism is dimension elevation, not sequential chakra-opening.
5. Foundation Meeting Videos: Access and the Gyaan-Befor e-Shakti Principle

1. Bhaiya announced that all Ashaeiynn Foundation meetings and training videos ar e recorded and made available under the Foundation's video section — members do not need to search elsewhere; everything is centrally accessible at any time. 2. "Gyaan milna bahut zar oori hai. Bina gyaan ke shakti nirarthak ho jaati hai" (Gaining knowledge is essential — without knowledge, power/shakti becomes meaningless) is of fered as a guiding principle for why watching the recorded material matters as much as receiving shakti itself. 3. The door -vs-wall analogy: pushing endlessly against a wall will never open it, no matter how much ef fort is applied — but pushing against something that is actually a door might open it. The point: ef fort must be paired with correct understanding (gyaan) of where and how to direct it, or it is wasted. 4. New videos are uploaded reliably the same night, befor e midnight , so members need not worry about delayed access to session recordings.
6. Live Q&A: Astral Body Chakra Activation vs. Physical Body Chakra Activation

1. A sangat member raised a live follow-up question, referencing an earlier conversation with a fellow member ("V ikas bhai"): during hawans, it is explained that the practitioner's astral body chakras are activated — but does this also produce visible, physical ef fects in the physical body , and how exactly do the two dif fer? 2. Bhaiya's explanation of Ashaeiynn's method: the practice works through mantra (specifically the name of Ram, transmitted through the guru's own mouth/lineage) to awaken tattvas (elements). Crucially , Ashaeiynn's appr oach never touches the

physical world first — it works exclusively on the astral world first , because "the physical world is only a manifestation of the astral world"; results appear in the physical world, but the actual work happens at the astral level. 3. The mantra's pr ogr ession thr ough the astral body: the mantra first circulates around the body at the astral level, then begins settling into the body at the astral level, then forms a complete pr otective kavach (armor) made of mantra at the astral level — only after this does chakra awakening occur , and this awakening, too, happens at the astral level. Hawan work raises astralworld dimension; it does not directly touch physical-world chakras at all. 4. Once the astral body is made sufficiently str ong , it automatically "engulfs" and aligns the physical body's chakras on its own — the physical chakras are never worked on directly; they fall into alignment as a byproduct of astral-level strength. 5. Permanence: once a practitioner's astral-level chakras are genuinely awakened through this method, they cannot close again for the rest of that person's life — the only exception being if the person comes under a major tantric/"mahatantrik" attack and simultaneously abandons their own mantra jap practice entirely . 6. Contrast with hatha yoga / Patanjali-style yoga paths: these paths work in the opposite direction — they activate the physical body's chakras dir ectly first , generating enough ener gy through that physical-level activation to subsequently open the astral chakras. 7. Why the hatha yoga path is consider ed difficult: because the highest concentration of ener gy in that path flows through the physical body first, practitioners on that path must maintain very strict discipline — diet, brahmacharya, and other rules — without exception. Any disruption (even something as small as an unplanned deviation) can immediately imbalance a physical chakra, which halts the ener gy flow at that point and blocks it from ever reaching the astral level. 8. Why Ashaeiynn's mantra-first method suits ordinary/undisciplined practitioners: this method is described as being for people who are comparatively "lazy" (aalasi) or unable to bind themselves to strict rules and restrictions. Because the practice works first on the astral world — something the practitioner is less directly , physically attached to — it can be built up steadily regardless of occasional physical lapses (Bhaiya's example: eating a packet of chips someone of fers). Such a lapse might temporarily imbalance a physical chakra, but the already-built astral-world strength is able to rebalance it again on its own. 9. This is why continuous jap matters mor e than perfect external discipline in this teaching: as long as jap continues without interruption, the astral-level strength keeps supplying continuous ener gy and correcting minor physical-level imbalances — the only real danger is a genuine blockage forming within the jap practice itself, which Bhaiya notes is rare in practice. 10. When physical-world manifestation begins: once the mantra's dimension reaches all the way into the physical world, visible "chamatkar" (miracles/wonders) begin occurring on their own, and practitioners typically start to intuitively understand this shift is happening within themselves without needing it explained.
7. A Brief Note on Death and Afterlife Myths (Deferr ed Topic)

1. Bhaiya raised — but explicitly deferred full explanation of — the question of whether messengers of Yamraj (the god of death) literally come for a person after death. His brief answer: no, this is not true; no such messengers come. A fuller explanation was promised for a future session, noting that longer -standing Ashaeiynn members have already heard this explained in earlier material. 2. Related brief remarks: after death, most pretas are simply left as they are, with no one attending to them — many wander aimlessly or remain in place, unaddressed. Opening one's own drishti would reveal the scale of this, but Bhaiya notes people rarely open drishti voluntarily because doing so would expose and shut down certain exploitative "businesses" built around people's fear and ignorance of these realities.
8. Advanced Astral-Level Capability: Self-Cutting Tantric Curses

1. Bhaiya notes that practitioners who reach a suf ficiently advanced level at the astral stage learn to cut tantric actions and curses (including "maran kriya," a lethal curse-type practice) dir ected at them, entir ely on their own — some advanced practitioners are able to neutralize such an attack within about an hour and continue on unaf fected. 2. Bhaiya references a newly-created YouT ube channel intended to regularly post review videos illustrating real examples of this kind of advanced self-protection, along with broader teaching on recognizing negativity , understanding dimension-related concepts, and communicating with tantriks.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

Kalyan Lok is a bridge-realm between Ashaeiynn and Pretaraj Sarkar , granted by 1 1 devi-devatas' permission, containing 16 sub-lokas — cleared negativity is purified, disciplined, and cycled onward there, rather than merely pushed away (the household-trash/dump-yard analogy). A chakra being "open" during aura-checking is not the same as it being at full intensity — chakras can be significantly underpowered (e.g., 30% active when 100% is needed) or overpowered (e.g., 200% from unsupervised meditation while others sit at 1-2%), and hawan work corrects both. Hawans do not open chakras one at a time — kundalini shakti breaks all chakras open in the very first jolt. What hawans actually do is raise overall dimension , roughly 5 dimensions per session, until 45-50 dimensions are crossed (typically around the 6th-7th chakra stage) — the threshold at which drishti becomes secure from outside tampering. "Chakra" terminology is a deliberately simplified, layman's framing for what is actually a dimension-raising process. All Ashaeiynn Foundation meetings/videos are recorded and centrally accessible, uploaded the same night before midnight — gyaan (knowledge) must accompany shakti (power), or the power becomes meaningless (the door -vs-wall analogy). Ashaeiynn's method works on the astral body first , never the physical body directly — mantra circulates, settles, forms a full kavach, then awakens chakras, all at the astral level; the physical body's chakras align automatically once the astral body is strong enough. Once genuinely awakened this way , astral-level chakras cannot close again except under a major tantric attack combined with total abandonment of mantra jap. Hatha yoga/Patanjali-style paths work in reverse (physical chakras first, then astral) and require strict unbroken discipline, since any physical lapse can immediately block the ener gy flow — this is why that path is considered dif ficult. Ashaeiynn's mantra-first approach suits practitioners who can't maintain such strict discipline: minor physical lapses get selfcorrected by already-built astral strength, provided jap itself is never abandoned. No literal messengers of Yamraj come for anyone after death — this teaching states plainly that this is false; a fuller explanation is deferred to a future session. Advanced practitioners can learn to self-cut tantric curses (including maran kriya) directed at them, sometimes within about an hour . Spelling note: the institute's name is written "Ashaeiynn" — use this spelling consistently .
Part II — Q&A Pairs (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Q&A Pairs (Session 31, English)
Kalyan Lok Explained, Chakra Intensity vs. Dimension, and Astral vs. Physical Chakra Activation
User-style questions with answers gr ounded in this Ashaeiynn Foundation session. Gr eeting style: "Jai Siya Ram."

Q1. What exactly is Kalyan Lok? A: Kalyan Lok is a realm that Bhaiya's own guru obtained specifically for the work of practitioners' sukshma sharir , granted with the permission of 1 1 devi-devatas. It contains 16 further sub-lokas within it, and functions as a bridge between Ashaeiynn and "Pretaraj Sarkar" — the realm through which cleared negativity is purified, disciplined, and cycled onward.

Q2. Why haven't I r ead about Kalyan Lok anywher e else? A: Because this realm has no single fixed scriptural name — dif ferent traditions refer to it by dif ferent names in dif ferent regions. "Kalyan Lok" is the specific name given by Bhaiya's own guru's instruction, not a universal or exclusive title.

Q3. Which deities ar e associated with Kalyan Lok? A: Eleven primary deities preside there, including Shiva-Shakti, Hanuman Ji Maharaj, Bhagwan Ram and Sita, three distinct forms of Vishnu Bhagwan, and three distinct forms of Bhaiya's own guru (appearing dif ferently there than in the physical world). One notable form is a black-colored (kala) Hanuman Ji Maharaj, specifically associated with burning away tantric curses and actions.

Q4. Why is negativity sent all the way to Kalyan Lok instead of just being clear ed away nearby? A: This teaching uses a household-trash analogy: a cleaning van takes waste far outside the city to a proper dump yard, rather than leaving it just outside the house, where it could simply blow back in. Kalyan Lok serves the same function for cleared negativity — relocating it to a place specifically designed to contain and process it, so it cannot easily return.

Q5. What actually happens to negativity once it's sent to Kalyan Lok? A: It under goes a purification process described as similar to beating dirt out of a heavily soiled cloth — a form of disciplining/suf fering. Once suf ficiently purified and categorized, it is reassigned onward to Pretaraj Sarkar , specifically so it can never return to the same person again.

Q6. If my aura-check alr eady shows a chakra as "active," why do I still need a hawan for that same chakra? A: Because a chakra being open is not the same as it being at full intensity — like water pressure in a pipe, a channel can be open while still flowing at only a fraction of the volume actually needed. Your chakra might be shown as "active" during an aura-check while still only being at, say , 30% of the 100% needed for full drishti-related ener gy flow .

Q7. Can a chakra become over charged rather than underpower ed? A: Yes — intensive, unsupervised meditation can cause one chakra (often the crown or a similar chakra) to become extremely overchar ged, even reaching something like 200%, while the remaining chakras stay severely underpowered. Hawan work in such cases reduces the overchar ged chakra and raises the underpowered ones, bringing the whole system back into balance.

Q8. Does a hawan literally open one chakra at a time, session by session? A: No — this teaching clarifies that all chakras actually break open together in the very first jolt (jhatka) of awakened kundalini shakti. What subsequent hawans do is raise the practitioner's overall "dimension," not open new chakras one by one.

Q9. How much does a single hawan session actually raise a practitioner's dimension? A: Roughly 5 dimensions per session, rising and settling in a repeating pattern. By the time a practitioner has been through work associated with six to seven chakras, they've typically crossed approximately 45 to 50 dimensions in total.

Q10. Why does cr ossing this dimension thr eshold matter? A: Because at roughly 45-50% dimension crossed, a practitioner's drishti becomes secure — it can no longer be easily tampered with or interfered with by outside forces.

Q1 1. If it's r eally about "dimension," why does Bhaiya talk about chakras at all? A: "Chakra" is used deliberately as a simplified, layman's term, because most members don't intuitively grasp a phrase like "we're raising your dimension." The chakra-by-chakra framing is easier to communicate, even though the underlying mechanism is dimension elevation.

Q12. Are all the Ashaeiynn Foundation training sessions r ecorded somewher e I can access later? A: Yes — all Foundation meetings and training videos are recorded and centrally available under the Foundation's video section. Members don't need to look elsewhere, and new videos are reliably uploaded the same night, before midnight.

Q13. Why does Bhaiya emphasize watching the videos so much, rather than just r eceiving shakti dir ectly? A: Because, per this teaching, "gyaan milna bahut zaroori hai — bina gyaan ke shakti nirarthak ho jaati hai" (gaining knowledge is essential; without knowledge, power becomes meaningless). The door -vs-wall analogy illustrates this: pushing endlessly against a wall never opens it, but pushing against an actual door might — ef fort needs to be paired with correct understanding of where to direct it.

Q14. During hawans, I'm told my astral body's chakras ar e activated — does that also change my physical body? A: Yes, indirectly . Ashaeiynn's method works exclusively on the astral world first, since "the physical world is only a manifestation of the astral world." Once the astral body is made strong enough, it automatically aligns and "engulfs" the physical body's chakras on its own — the physical chakras are never worked on directly , but they do fall into alignment as a result.

Q15. What actually happens to the mantra as it works thr ough my astral body? A: It follows a progression: first circulating around the body at the astral level, then settling into the body , then forming a complete protective kavach (armor) made of mantra — only after this does chakra awakening occur , and all of this happens at the astral level before any physical-level change appears.

Q16. Once my astral chakras ar e awakened this way , can they ever close again? A: According to this teaching, no — not for the rest of that person's life, with one exception: coming under a major tantric/"mahatantrik" attack while simultaneously abandoning one's own mantra jap practice entirely .

Q17. How is this differ ent from the hatha yoga or Patanjali-style yoga appr oach to chakras? A: That approach works in the reverse direction — it activates the physical body's chakras directly first, generating enough ener gy through that physical-level work to subsequently open the astral chakras.

Q18. Why is the hatha yoga path consider ed so difficult? A: Because its highest ener gy concentration flows through the physical body first, practitioners must maintain very strict, unbroken discipline (diet, brahmacharya, and other rules). Any disruption can immediately imbalance a physical chakra, halting the ener gy flow and blocking it from reaching the astral level at all.

Q19. I'm not very disciplined — can this practice still work for me? A: Yes — this teaching describes Ashaeiynn's mantra-first method as specifically suited to people who can't maintain strict rules. Because the practice builds astral-world strength first (something you're less directly physically attached to), occasional physical lapses (Bhaiya's example: eating chips someone of fers) may temporarily imbalance a physical chakra, but the already-built astral strength rebalances it on its own.

Q20. Does that mean I don't need any discipline at all, as long as I keep doing my jap? A: This teaching's emphasis is that continuous jap matters more than perfect external discipline — as long as jap continues without interruption, astral-level strength keeps supplying ener gy and correcting minor physical-level imbalances. The real danger would be a genuine blockage forming within the jap practice itself, which is described as rare in practice.

Q21. When do I actually start seeing r eal-world, physical changes fr om my practice? A: Once the mantra's dimension reaches all the way into the physical world, visible "chamatkar" (wonders/miracles) begin happening on their own, and practitioners typically start to intuitively sense this shift happening within themselves.

Q22. Do messengers of Yamraj r eally come to take a person after death? A: No — this teaching states plainly that this is not true; no such messengers come. A fuller explanation of what actually happens after death was deferred to a future session.

Q23. What actually happens to most people/spirits after death, then? A: Per this teaching's brief remarks, most pretas are simply left as they are, with no one attending to them — many wander aimlessly or remain in place unaddressed. Opening one's own drishti would reveal the true scale of this, though most people never do, partly because it would expose and shut down certain exploitative practices built around people's fear of the unknown.

Q24. Can advanced practitioners r eally cut curses or negative tantric actions aimed at them, on their own? A: Yes — this teaching describes suf ficiently advanced practitioners at the astral stage learning to cut tantric actions and curses (including "maran kriya") directed at them, sometimes neutralizing an attack within about an hour .

Q25. Is ther e anywher e I can see r eal examples of this kind of advanced self-pr otection? A: Bhaiya references a newly-created YouT ube channel intended to regularly post review videos illustrating real examples of this, alongside broader teaching on recognizing negativity , dimension-related concepts, and communicating with tantriks.

Q26. Do I need money to participate in Ashaeiynn's practices? A: Money is only needed for practical hawan logistics — Bhaiya states plainly that no payment is required from anyone who genuinely cannot af ford it, and consistent jap itself is promised to eventually yield everything a sincere practitioner needs.
Bot Response Guidelines (Session 31 additions)

When explaining Kalyan Lok, present it as this teaching's own cosmological framework (guru-given terminology) rather than asserting it as the universally recognized name for this realm across all traditions. When explaining chakra "activation" vs. dimension, keep the water -pressure-in-a-pipe and door -vs-wall analogies intact, since they are the source teaching's own chosen illustrations — don't substitute other metaphors. Be clear that Ashaeiynn's method works on the astral body first and never directly manipulates physical-body chakras — this distinction is central to how this teaching frames its approach as dif ferent from hatha yoga/Patanjali-style paths. When a user asks whether they can be less strict/disciplined and still benefit, reflect this teaching's actual claim (continuous jap matters most, occasional physical lapses self-correct) without implying discipline or ethical conduct don't matter at all. On the death/Y amraj-messengers question, keep the answer brief and note that a fuller explanation was deferred to a future session — do not fabricate the fuller explanation. When discussing pretas being "left unaddressed" after death, handle with sensitivity , especially if a user's question relates to a personal bereavement. Spelling note: the institute's name is written "Ashaeiynn" — use this spelling consistently .
